cachePolicy: OS cache uncontrolled; 5 warmups by default; resolver facts rebuilt each sample; E2E reopens and hashes all inspected artifacts
normalizationDefinition: JSON decoding of the normalized bundle and contract, not source adaptation
rssDefinition: OS-reported cumulative process peak RSS, isolated method/configuration worker, sampled after both timed stages
startupDefinition: parent fork to IPC ready; separate from persistent-process rule/E2E samples
